newsitem.title: POLAND: Universal to spend PLN 1.5 mln on buyback.
newsitem.headline: Universal to spend PLN 1.5 mln on buyback.

text.p: Polish trading company Universal SA plans to earmark about 1.5 million zlotys of its 1996 23-million-zloty net profit on buying back its own shares in order to retire them, Universal said in a statement on Tuesday.
Universal said the remaining 21.6-million-zlotys of the net profit would be earmarked for reserve capital. The proposal needs to be approved by a general shareholders' meeting.
Universal also said CBM Pekao SA brokerage would service as the custodian to Universal's planned issue of ADRs, which would amount to up to 9.78 percent of the firm's shares in public trade.
On Monday, Universal said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) had given it a final approval to issue the ADRs.
